title: Heated Seat Pad 45 × 90 cm – 4 Heating Zones, USB-Powered
seo_title: Heated Seat Pad 45 × 90 cm With 4 Heating Zones
seo_description: USB-powered heated seat pad 45 × 90 cm with 4 heating zones and 3 settings. Covers seat and back. Power bank not included.
descriptionHtml:
The cold seat is felt in your whole body before you've even sat down

The car seat, office chair or camping chair is ice cold when you sit down in the morning or out in the cold, and it takes a while before the warmth comes on its own. You sit there freezing for no reason before your body has time to warm itself up.

A seat pad that warms the chair you sit in

The heated seat pad is 45 × 90 cm and covers both seat and back with 4 heating zones. It runs on USB (power bank not included) and has 3 settings you switch between with a button.

Features

  • The pad warms where you sit and where you lean – 4 heating zones cover both seat and back.
  • Choose between three heat levels – three settings are selected with a button on the pad.
  • Runs easily on USB – connects with a standard USB cable (power bank not included).
  • Seat and back are heated in one piece – size 45 × 90 cm covers both.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
